view_roles.perspective: combined spire, mouth and basal extension

concept.reason: Primary published specimen photo establishes taper, whorl profile, small preserved aperture and scale; diagnostic primary text covers morphology. This rotational shell permits conservative explicit unseen-side inference. No extra concept requested or needed; no denied media request bypass.

original_scope: Genus-level original low-poly fossil study of a long tapering spire, flattened to weakly convex whorl flanks and a small terminal aperture. No soft parts.
scope_correction: Original inventory adjective very tall/extremely tall had no numeric ratio and was provisional. Verified type species specimen is about 2.7:1, not a 5:1 needle. Root approved evidence-led correction 2026-10-22 20:25 UTC. Preserve real Nerinea proportions; do not borrow Eunerinea, stretch the specimen or claim the original extreme adjective is proven.

reference_anchor.source: Kollmann2014 Fig5C pp358–359; museum catalogue independently confirms identity
reference_anchor.locality: La Combe de Vaux, Ain, France
reference_anchor.views: One published apertural-oblique photograph with 10mm scale bar. Fig5B is a DIFFERENT same-species section and is context only, not copied internal anatomy. Fig5A is a different species. Other panels are other genera and excluded.
reference_anchor.scope: Original low-poly interpretation of factual shell construction, not photogrammetry or a specimen replica.

scale.evidence: Fig5C: paper states scale bars10mm. In rendered page1172x1640, bar x678–727=49px; fossil y242–530=288px, width about108px. Thus projected height58.8mm and width22.0mm. Depth21mm is inferred from a rounded shell body, not directly measured.
scale.engineering_tolerance: Height56–62mm, width20–24mm, inferred depth19–24mm. These are design tolerances, not biological confidence limits.

morphology: Tall tapered cone with about9–10 visible turns and low rounded worn apex. Main shaft outline nearly straight, widening gradually; whorl sides are flattened to gently convex, not a stack of spheres. Keep sutures shallow and oblique/helical.

Last whorl broadens into rounded shoulder and narrows toward a short, somewhat bent basal siphonal extension. Do not make a long modern whelk siphonal tube or an uninterrupted cone ending in a flat disk.

Small narrow terminal aperture occupies the lower front-right in the primary view. Preserve its slant, surrounding lip/columellar mass and short basal notch/extension. It is not a giant round Turritella opening.

Preserved aperture is almost complete per author, but rough mineral and wear obscure the lumen and part of lip. Model a modest shallow inset with a small mineral-filled region and surviving raised rim, not a fully empty invented dark tunnel and not a solid blob with no mouth.
Subdued visible growth lines and broad irregular wear only. No spines, pronounced axial ribs, repeated black rings, exaggerated beads, chamber septa, external elaborate plait ribs or pseudo-ornament.
Matte pale tan fossil, simplified restrained faceting. No matrix pedestal, labels, ink, scale bars, photographic textures, copied scan or trace-derived mesh.
uncertainty: Only the front-oblique exterior is independently photographed in the successfully accessed paper. Far flank and depth inferred from continuous dextral shell construction; use smooth conservative continuation, do not fabricate hidden damage. Four renders are presentation/evaluation views, not claims of four observed specimen views.
10 approximate visible turns including tiny apical turns; erosion limits exact count. Overall ratio and shallow flanks are more important than an invented exact turn count.
Aperture cavity depth, missing thin lip and precise internal folds are not resolved. Do not invent deep anatomy or recreate Fig5B cross-section in an exterior model.

The literal extremely tall wording is unsupported by selected type-species specimen; maintain real2.7:1 ratio. Historical Nerinea usage included taxa reassigned to Eunerinea; do not transfer those shapes.
Colour is an artistic stone palette, not a biological colour claim.
palette: Matte tan/beige shell and slightly darker neutral mineral infill;2–4 restrained tones.
acceptance_focus: Front: about2.7:1 total height-to-width,9–10 shallow whorls, continuous tapered cone, visible small slanted lower aperture with short bent basal extension.
Side: rounded three-dimensional whorls rather than flat relief; gradual taper and restrained aperture projection. Depth is inferred, not a reported measured fact.
Top: coherent continuous coiling and body thickness, not loose stacked cylinders or disconnected shells.
Perspective: mouth connects physically to body, observed shallow preservation retained; no giant hole, overly broad lip or long whelk canal.

Maker must inspect Fig5C before blockout and provide four real renders, actual geometry tests, self-contained pinned dependencies and two isolated deterministic rebuilds. Prep is not scientific/modelPASS.
